text:
Alex Chen: FYI opened a docs PR to clarify time sync + HSM flakiness in sealed/private installs: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4567
Maya Singh: Nice — can you call out the exact failure mode? was it PKCS#11 handshake timeouts or TLS reconnects?
Alex Chen: PKCS#11 handshake timeouts. Host clock drift >5s caused auth failures when the HSM verifies timestamps. Minimal installer profile disables systemd-timesyncd and our sealed offline profile didn't include chrony or ntp.
Samir Patel: Oof. Do we want to force-install a time daemon in airgapped mode? we originally avoided network daemons for sealed images.
Alex Chen: Proposal in PR: recommend chrony by default for private installs, plus an explicit RTC fallback for fully airgapped sites. Snippet included.
Samir Patel: Please make the snippet airgap-safe (no public pools).
Alex Chen: Agreed. Current PR snippet (will adjust per feedback):

```
# enable chrony (example)
apt-get install -y chrony
cat >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf <<'EOF'
# for sealed/offline installs: configure your local NTP server or use the local RTC
# server 10.0.0.5 iburst
# or for local RTC fallback:
refclock PHC /dev/ptp0 poll 4
local stratum 10
makestep 1.0 3
EOF
systemctl enable --now chrony
```

Maya Singh: Don't leave `server 10.0.0.5` as-is — replace with `# configure to your offline NTP server` and include an explicit `127.127.1.0` (RTC) example. Also add a short note that public pools must not be used in sealed docs. :+1:
Kevin O'Leary: Another real-world gotcha: systemd-resolved or network changes rewriting /etc/hosts caused hostname lookups to change, which broke HSM's configured socket path when people used short hostnames. Add a note to use absolute PKCS11 paths and a systemd drop-in to lock the working dir.
Alex Chen: Good call. I'll add a systemd service drop-in suggestion to set ReadWritePaths and ensure plugin runs with fixed cwd. Also will call out absolute paths for `pkcs11_module` and `token_label`.
Samir Patel: For the HSM section include quick checks: `sudo chronyc tracking || timedatectl status` and `journalctl -u hsm-plugin -n 200` plus an example grep for PKCS11 errors: `journalctl -u hsm-plugin | grep -i pkcs11`. And permissions: `chmod 640 /var/lib/hsm/keys && chown hsmuser:hsm /var/lib/hsm/keys`.
Maya Singh: Can we add a one-line installer preflight checklist near the top of the private install guide? e.g. time sync, /etc/hosts stable, pkcs11 absolute path, cert chain present, apt mirror reachable.
Alex Chen: Yep — PR now contains a compact preflight checklist and a pointer to the offline apt-mirror guide. Also added a short troubleshooting subsection: "Time skew & HSM auth" with sample log output.
Alex Chen: Ping @docs-bot to run linkcheck on the PR — some internal links changed when I moved the apt-mirror page.
docs-bot: Linkcheck started for PR #4567 — running checks across 42 files. Results expected in ~8m.
Kevin O'Leary: If linkcheck flags the RTC example as an external reference, mark it as an allowed placeholder and add a comment explaining why it's a placeholder.
Maya Singh: LGTM once the PR removes any public pool examples and adds the RTC & local-server comments. Also add the systemd drop-in example for the HSM plugin.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — will update now and request a final review. Targeting merge after one more pass.
